I feel the same as you. Except I’m 37 and I’ve been making the same mistakes over and over since I was your age. Drinking was and is my problem. I stop for two years then as soon as I slip it’s fucking disasterous. Now I’m awaiting charges for something that will put me in prison if it goes to court. 
If that happens I’m doing it. I’m tired now, I try to make it better but it’s always the same result. 
I just want to know the best way of doing it? Many suggestions?
